# Order relations (C14): a relation as said after a copula ("is older than"), '=', its inverse,
# the superlative of the one that stands above all ("oldest"), and the superlative of the one
# all stand above ("youngest"), separated by ';'. A conception "X is older than Y" bonds X to Y
# with the relation; "Y is younger than X" bonds the same. The bonds give an order, and the
# superlatives, with an ordinal ("second youngest"), ask for a place in it.
